# MSGHEADER

**PPL language/runtime 4.00 - value record.**

[Object model and calling conventions](../objects.md) | [API index](index.md)

A mutable local message header value: From, To, Subject and IsPrivate. Assigning or passing it copies the value; changes do not write to the message base.

[Behavior, constraints and examples](../../../new_ppl.md#composing-and-editing-messages).

Fields are writable on the local value; modifying a copy does not write back to the board.

## From

`MSGHEADER.From: STRING`

Writable field.

Editable header default, copied by value. Blank From uses the session identity. Sender changes require permission; message area security still applies.

## IsPrivate

`MSGHEADER.IsPrivate: BOOLEAN`

Writable field.

Editable header default, copied by value. Blank From uses the session identity. Sender changes require permission; message area security still applies.
